title: Explicit form of the record template
statement: For any types $Q,T$ and natural numbers $n,s$, the record template consists of two fields: the binary digits of $n+1$, encoded as digit symbols, followed by a field of $2s+1$ blank-content cell symbols whose head marker is true exactly at the middle cell. Equivalently, the second field has marker pattern $s$ false entries, then true, then $s$ false entries.
